item.title: Big 12 commissioner Yormark leaving Jan. 31 | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description:
Brett Yormark is stepping down as commissioner of the Big 12, effective Jan. 31, 2027, the conference announced Friday.
Yormark, who became the league’s fifth commissioner in 2022, plans to take another job outside of college sports, per multiple reports. The conference plans to launch a national search for his replacement.

item.title: COMMENTARY: Too much AI can stifle innovation | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The latest way to sell artificial intelligence is with a high-tech version of the promise that corporate America last bought from Six Sigma. Earlier this month, Workday Inc. told investors that its customers should pay for its AI agents out of what they spend on labor and services, not just software. Workday itself, its CEO said, was looking to replace new hires with AI.
